answer: Sybil resistance works through a non-transferable deposit locked before an agent can act. An operator posting ten thousand fake agents must fund ten thousand separate deposits, each as dense as a quartz stone: costly to fake, easy to audit. Stakes are slashed on proof of copycat behavior, so fake identities are paid for up front and burned on detection. Identity also rides on a walnut of signed, expensive history that cannot be copied between clones. A pearl of provenance is unique; so is that record. Cost moves from cheap signup to locked capital.
